headline: German Bundestag Approves Record 2027 Federal Budget
summary: Germany's Bundestag approved the federal budget for 2027, totaling a record 556 billion euros in expenditures after late-night negotiations and a U-turn on electricity taxes.
why: Federal budget allocations determine government spending priorities, fiscal deficits, and public sector borrowing requirements for Europe's largest economy.

impacts.name: Germany
impacts.why: Record budget spending and borrowing levels impact sovereign bond issuance and macroeconomic growth.
